display.label: AWS Launch Template
display.description: Create and manage Amazon EC2 Launch Templates with AMIs, instance sizing, storage mappings, and network configurations

globals.label: AWS Region
globals.description: The AWS region where resources will be provisioned.

resource.key_description: Unique identifier name for the launch template. Serves as map key.

sections.label: Basic Configuration
sections.description: Core launch template identification and version management.

fields.label: Launch Template Name
fields.description: The name of the launch template.

validation.pattern_error: Name must contain only alphanumeric characters, dots, underscores, dashes, and parentheses.

fields.label: Name Prefix
fields.description: Creates a unique name beginning with the specified prefix. Conflicts with name.

fields.label: Description
fields.placeholder: Launch template for web application tier

fields.label: Update Default Version
fields.description: Whether to update Default Version each time the template is updated.

sections.label: Compute & Instance Settings
sections.description: AMI selection, instance sizing, key pairs, and IAM instance profile.

fields.label: AMI ID
fields.description: The AMI ID to use to launch the instance (e.g., ami-0c55b159cbfafe1f0).

fields.label: Instance Type
fields.description: The EC2 instance type to use for instances launched from this template.

fields.label: Key Pair Name
fields.description: The name of the EC2 Key Pair to use for SSH access.

fields.label: IAM Instance Profile Name
fields.description: The name of the IAM instance profile to associate with the instance.

fields.label: IAM Instance Profile ARN
fields.description: The ARN of the IAM instance profile to associate with the instance.

fields.label: EBS Optimized
fields.description: If true, launched instances will be EBS-optimized.

fields.label: VPC Security Group IDs
fields.description: A list of security group IDs to associate with instances.

sections.label: User Data
sections.description: Bootstrap shell script or cloud-init configuration executed on first boot.

fields.label: User Data Script
fields.description: The user data script (plain text or base64 encoded).

fields.label: Configure Metadata Options
fields.description: Whether to configure instance metadata options.

fields.label: HTTP Endpoint
fields.description: Enable or disable the HTTP metadata endpoint.

fields.label: HTTP Tokens (IMDSv2)
fields.description: Whether IMDSv2 session tokens are required.

fields.label: HTTP PUT Response Hop Limit
fields.description: Desired HTTP PUT response hop limit for metadata requests (1-64).

fields.label: Instance Metadata Tags
fields.description: Enables or disables access to instance tags from instance metadata.

sections.label: Tags
sections.description: Resource tags assigned to the launch template.

fields.label: Resource Tags
fields.description: Key-value tags assigned to the launch template.
